context.purpose: Station an ordered WGS84 route at true ellipsoidal (geodesic) distances, continuously across turning points, with labelled station and leg tables, station and route GeoJSON and an independently verified length summary.
context.assumptions: WGS84 ellipsoid, longitude-first decimal degrees parsed to binary64, shortest geodesic per leg; isolated pyproj 3.8.0 / PROJ 9.9.0 on POSIX with network disabled; numerical agreement under a conditional engineering model only.
context.constraints: Every point of every leg within |latitude| <= 75; no antimeridian crossing; legs 0.01 m-5000 km; total <= 20000 km; 2-500 waypoints; <= 10000 rows; capture <= 1 MiB; spacing 0.1 m-1000 km; a requested endpoint gap must stay inside the same leg domain.
context.inspection: Inspect stations.csv, legs.csv, the GeoJSON, route-summary.json (host decision, numerical bands, presentation) and route-verification.json (bindings, agreement and adequacy ratios).
context.recovery: Correct located CSV, geography and domain faults by editing waypoints or spacing; VERIFICATION_INDETERMINATE means agreement could not be established; unmet or indeterminate requirements are retained evidence, not accepted results.

workflow.scope: Verified table and GeoJSON artifacts hand off by index; only accepted runs (requirements met or none) can be consumed.

composition.scope: Shared references, expressions and finite studies resolve to the same literal route contract.

lifecycle.timeout: One total deadline (default 120 s) over host prechecks, both native stages and host verification, with no per-stage reset; native CPU 60 s, address space 2 GiB, 16 MiB per file.
lifecycle.cancellation: Owned process-group cancellation through the shared runner, plus cancellation and deadline checkpoints inside host verification and before publication.
lifecycle.logs: Captured CSV, authored/plan/native configuration, worker and implementation fingerprints, consumed-input bindings, submissions, stdout/stderr, native result and readback records, empty private native home.
lifecycle.verification: Independent standard-library oracle (Gauss-Legendre quadrature of the auxiliary-sphere integrals with Newton inverse/direct and a 1 mm local-metric regime): executable tau/10 adequacy for legs, station forwards, consecutive inverses and the requested gap, then agreement within tau; host-owned decision recomputed by saved verification.

losses: Decimal text is parsed to binary64; latitude-first headers are refused.
data.scope: Regular local capture <= 1 MiB, 2-500 waypoints; complete host validation before native launch.

cases.scope: Winnipeg City Hall - Selkirk - Lockport at 1 km stations across the leg boundary. Expected lengths and azimuths come from the independent standard-library oracle (quadrature theory, not pyproj); tolerances are 2 tau for lengths and 1e-8 degrees for azimuths.
Closed Winnipeg - Selkirk - Steinbach triangle at 2 km stations: closing leg appended, final row repeats waypoint 1. Oracle expectations as baseline.
Exact equatorial arcs: lengths a x delta-longitude (a = 6378137 m), azimuths exactly 90 degrees, every station at latitude 0.

completion.scope: Initial routeStations route: all fields, strict CSV and closed domain, chainage/merge rules, endpoint-gap domain, executable adequacy, host-owned requirements, saved verification, retained-input provenance, workflow handoff.
